# P34.23 — Versioning discipline + one version source (REL-10)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-REL-014** (spec §56.6; G3 §9 codebase
versioning — this row owns it) · **cited:** SIG-ENG-003 (ADR-195),
SIG-REL-004/005 (the release descriptor fields this corrects),
SIG-MEM-007 (the `ci:` line), OP-08 (operator-only tags) · **findings
answered:** NEW-3/GT-7 — every release's `resolver_version` and
`renderer.version` read `0.0.0` · **Base:**
`r11/P34.22b-date-truth-fixtures-and-sources-dates-v2` (chain tip —
merge after it) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/227_P34.23__versioning-discipline-one-version-source.md`
(manifest row 227 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Live stage:**
**none** — `live_verification=false`; no production mutations (OM-14);
not an OM-20 row; **no tag is placed** — `v0.1.0` is the operator's

## Why

Versions came from three disagreeing places: every `pyproject.toml` and
`web/package.json` already read `0.1.0`, while 11 of 14 `__init__.py`
files hard-coded `__version__ = "0.0.0"` (the other three hard-coded
`"0.1.0"` — still a second source that can silently drift). The release
descriptor inherited it: `run_spine_export` stamped `resolver_version`
with the exports package's own placeholder, so the GATE-G3-signed
manifest reads `resolver_version 0.0.0`, `renderer.version 0.0.0`. A
public-behaviour change could also merge without a CHANGELOG entry —
nothing enforced it. And the operator had no written tag procedure nor
the agent-filled template G3 §9.2 prescribes.

## What this does

- **One version source (G3 §9.3):** all 14 packages derive
  `__version__ = _dist_version("sig-<pkg>")` via `importlib.metadata` —
  the pyproject/package.json pair is the only declaration point and
  `uv sync` the only refresh; a missing install raises loudly rather
  than falling back to a literal. `tests/unit/test_version_source.py`
  asserts pyproject == installed metadata == `__version__` ==
  `web/package.json` for every member, that none reports `0.0.0`, and
  that each `__init__.py` *derives* (a correct literal fails too — it
  is a second source). `git grep '"0.0.0"'` on package sources is
  empty; the `0.0.0`s that remain are frozen historical records under
  `docs/build/reports/` — evidence, never edited.
- **`scripts/bump_version.py <x.y.z>`** bumps the `[project] version`
  of all 14 member pyprojects (read live from
  `tool.uv.workspace.members`) plus `web/package.json` — dry-run by
  default, `--apply` writes, `0.0.0` and non-`x.y.z` refused, the
  `uv sync`/`make gen` follow-ups printed (lock regeneration is not
  the script's job — the bump touches version files and nothing else).
  `tests/unit/test_bump_version.py` drives it on a temp copy and proves
  unrelated content is untouched.
- **`resolver_version` = resolution version + `+g<commit8>`**
  (`exports/versioning.py`, wired into `run_spine_export`): the
  resolver's *code* identity is `resolution.__version__` plus the
  tree's commit, read via `git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD` — from the
  tree, never typed. No git tree → the bare resolution version, never
  a fabricated suffix. An explicit caller-supplied `resolver_version`
  still wins (the test seam is unchanged). `renderer.version` now
  reports the exports package's real `0.1.0` — so the deterministic
  prior-release pin in `ops/release_publish_verify.py` is re-based
  (`p-81f1986a…` → `p-fd7ba6a2…`, the same corpus under the truthful
  renderer; recorded in a comment).
- **CHANGELOG discipline (G3 §9.4):** `## [Unreleased]` with the
  Keep-a-Changelog sections and this ticket's entry; the section
  documents the no-typed-date heading convention and the gate's path
  set. `docs/build/tools/changelog_gate.py` (`changelog-gate/1`,
  stdlib-only) judges a `BASE...HEAD` range: touching
  `web/src/pages|layouts/**`, `api/{routes,app,models}.py`,
  `exports/{release*,spine_export,manifest}.py`, the two ops tomls,
  `policy/**` or `ontology/src/**` without a `CHANGELOG.md` change is a
  violation (exit 1), unless a commit's final paragraph carries
  `Changelog: none (<reason>)` (check_trailers grammar; an empty
  `()` does not count). Vacuous (3) and unknown (5) are never green.
  **CI config changed (H2 §4.7/CI-8):** the `docs` job gains a
  PR-only step running the gate; `make ci-local` runs the same gate
  over the same computed range (the tool joins the by-name whitelist
  in `test_ci_workflows.py` — its span legitimately differs locally).
- **Tag procedure + prepared v0.1.0 file**
  (`docs/build/reports/releases/`): `TAGGING.md` — the operator's
  annotated-tag procedure (merge sitting → head-bound green CI →
  `rev-parse <merge>^{tree}` == the recorded tree → `git tag -a`; no
  typed date anywhere — the tag object carries it). `TAG_TEMPLATE.md`
  — agents fill it in the last stack PR of a range. `TAG_v0.1.0.md`
  — prepared for the #141–#190 sitting: tree
  `64a23cd7c0330fa23c93d659c96e7da94df59934` (verified =
  `b051732c^{tree}`, the pinned stack tip per LEDGER), pinned-head CI
  run `36494519255` 5/5 green (verified via `gh`; the operator replaces
  it with the merge commit's run), included PRs #141–#190, production
  labels `sig-2026-08-20-95c7a19a` / `sig-2026-09-24-bd01cb94` /
  `sig-2026-09-27-ce480ab1` linked to their committed records.
  Marked **"not tagged — operator action"**.
- **ADR-195** records the owned decisions (dist-name convention, the
  honest bare-version fallback, the trailer grammar, PR-only gate
  scope) with a revisit trigger; registered in the ADR index, Appendix
  F (spec rebuilt byte-identical), `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` and BL-084.

## What this does NOT do

No tag placed, no merge/push of `main`, no GitHub release, no
production mutation (the `v0.1.0` tag stays the operator's OP-08
action — the prepared file records the prerequisite, it does not claim
it); no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick; frozen records
untouched (`db/sqitch.plan` L44–52, committed `corpus_release`/`corpus_registry`
bytes, historical manifests with their recorded `0.0.0`s); no
`UPDATE`/`DELETE` on the claim spine; release identity v2 stays with
P35.12, release-landing↔tag linkage with P35.13; no live/public/human
claim (`live_verification=false` — every verification here is
engineered/fixture).

**Size note (OM-16):** ~1,370 changed lines excluding generated files
(spec build, ADR index, `BACKLOG.md` mirror, `current/*` projection)
